title: 第七章 碗水
content_zh:
杏花巷有口水井，名叫铁锁井，一根粗如青壮手臂的铁链，年复一年，垂挂于井口内，何时有此水井有此铁锁，又是何人做此无聊事奇怪事，早已无人知晓真相，就连小镇岁数最大的老人，也说不出个子丑寅卯来。
传闻小镇曾经有好事者，试图检验铁链到底有多长，不顾老人们的劝阻，对于“拽铁锁出井口者，每出一尺，折寿一年”，这条口口相传的老规矩，那人根本没当回事，结果使劲拉扯了一炷香后，拔出一大堆铁链，仍是没有看到尽头的迹象，那人已是精疲力尽，便任由那些拽出井口的铁链，盘曲在水井轱辘旁，说是明天再来，他就偏偏不信这个邪了。此人回到家后，当天便七窍流血，暴毙在床上，而且死不瞑目，不管家人如何费劲折腾，尸体就是闭不上眼睛，最后有一个世世代代住在水井附近的老人，让那户人家抬着尸体到水井旁边，“眼睁睁”看着老人将那些铁链放回水井，等到整条铁链重新笔直没入井口深水中，那具尸体终于闭眼了。
一老一小缓缓走向那口铁锁井，小家伙，是个还挂着两条鼻涕虫的孩子，可是说起这个故事来，口齿清晰，有条不紊，根本不像是个才蒙学半年的乡野小娃娃，此时孩子正仰起头，大大的眼睛，像两颗黑葡萄，轻轻抽了抽鼻子，两条鼻涕小蛇就缩回去，孩子望着那个一手托着大白碗的说书先生，努努嘴，说道：“我说完了，你也该给我看看你碗里装着啥了吧？”
老人笑呵呵道：“别急别急，等到了水井边上坐下来，再给你看个够。”
孩子“善意”提醒道：“不许反悔，要不然你不得好死，刚到铁锁井旁边就会一头栽进去，到时候我可不会给你捞尸体，要不然就突然打了个雷，刚好把你劈成一块焦炭，到时候我就拿块石头，一点点敲碎……”
老人听着孩子竹筒倒豆子，一大串不带重复的恶毒晦气话，实在有些头疼，赶紧说道：“肯定给你看，对了，你这些话是跟谁学的？”
孩子斩钉截铁道：“跟我娘呗！”
老人感慨道：“不愧是人杰地灵，钟灵毓秀。”
孩子突然停下脚步，皱眉道：“你骂人不是？我知道有些人喜欢把好话反着说，比如宋集薪！”
老人连忙否认，然后岔开话题，问道：“小镇上是不是经常发生一些怪事？”
孩子点点头。
老人问道：“说说看。”
孩子指了指老人，一本正经道：“比如说你拎个大白碗，又不肯让人放铜钱进去。你还没说完故事的时候，我娘就说你讲得不坏，云里雾里，一看就是坑蒙拐骗惯了的，所以让我给你送几文钱，你死活不要，碗里到底有啥？”
老人哭笑不得。
原来是先前在老槐树下说完故事的说书先生，让这个孩子领着自己去杏花巷看那口水井，孩子起先不乐意，老人就说他这大白碗可有大讲究，装着了不得的稀罕玩意儿。那孩子天生活泼好动，被爹娘说成是个投胎的时候忘了长屁股的，他很小就喜欢跟着刘羡阳那帮浪荡子四处瞎逛，但是为了钓上一条黄鳝或是泥鳅，这小屁孩也能够在太阳底下暴晒半个时辰，一动不动，耐心惊人。
所以当老人说那白碗里装着什么，孩子立即就咬饵上钩。
哪怕老人一开始提了个古怪要求，说要试试提起他，看他到底有多沉，想知道有没有四十斤重，孩子毫不犹豫点头答应了，反正给人提几下也不会掉块肉。
但是让孩子一次次翻白眼的事情发生了，左手掌心托碗的老人，卯足劲用右手足足提了他五六次，可一次也没能把他成功提起来，孩子最后斜瞥了眼老人的细胳膊细腿，摇了摇头，心想同样是瘦杆子，陈平安那个穷光蛋的力气，就比这个老头子大多了。只是想着自己还没瞧见白碗里头的光景，仿佛天生早早开窍的孩子，就忍着没说一些会让老人下不来台的言语，要知道，在泥瓶巷杏花巷这一带，论吵架骂街，尤其是阴阳怪气说话，这个孩子能排第三，第二是读书人宋集薪，第一则是这个孩子他娘。
老人来到水井旁，但是没有去坐在井口上。
古井由青砖堆砌，

无形之中，老人呼吸沉重起来。
孩子走到水井旁，背对着井口，往后一蹦，屁股刚好坐在井口上。
这一幕看得老人冷汗直流，这要是一个不留神，那个兔崽子可就直接掉下去了啊，以这口古井的历史渊源，收尸都难。
老人缓缓向前几步，眯起眼，俯身审视着那条铁锁，一端捆绑死结于水井轱辘底部。
“风水胜地，甲于一洲。”
老人环顾四周，百感交集，心想道：“又不知道此件重器，最后会花落谁家？”
老人伸出空闲的左手，凝视手心。
掌心纹路，斑驳复杂。
但是出现了一条崭新纹路，正在缓缓延伸，如同瓷器崩裂出来的缝隙。
神人观掌，如看山河。
只不过这位老人，当下只是在看自身罢了。
老人皱起眉头，惊叹道：“不过短短半天，就已是这般惨淡光景，那几位岂不是？”
孩子已经站在井口上，一手叉腰，一手指着老人，大声催促道：“你到底给不给我看白碗？！”
老人无奈道：“你赶紧下来，赶紧下来，我这就给你看大白碗。”
孩子将信将疑，最后还是跳下井口。
老人犹豫片刻，脸色肃穆，“小娃儿，你我有缘，给你看看这碗的玄妙，也无不可，但是看过之后，你不许对外人提起，便是你那位娘亲，也不行，你若是做得到，我便让你见识见识，若是做不到，便是被你小娃儿戳脊梁骨，也不给你看半眼。”
孩子眨了眨眼睛，“开始吧。”
老人郑重其事地向前走到井口旁边，一低头，发现兔崽子这次换成双脚岔开坐在井口上，老人有些后悔自己招惹这个无法无天的小娃儿了。
老人收敛杂念，面朝井口，五指抓住大白碗的碗底，掌心开始微微倾斜，幅度几乎微不可查。
孩子感觉自己等了挺久，也没见头顶那个白碗有丝毫动静，老头子也始终保持那个姿势。

就在孩子的两条鼻涕虫快要挂到嘴边，耐心耗尽的前一刻。
只见手指粗细的一股水流，从白碗中倾泻而出，坠入水井深处，无声无息。
孩子呲牙，就要破口大骂。
他突然闭上嘴巴，有些惊讶，片刻后，孩子的脸色已经从震惊变成茫然，再然后，孩子开始恐惧，猛然回过神，一下子跳下井口，往自己家逃去。
原来，老人用那只白碗倒入水井的分量，早就一大水缸都不止了。
可是一直有水从白碗向外倒出。
孩子觉得自己肯定是白天见鬼了。
————
刘羡阳随手从路边折了一根刚抽芽的树枝，开始练剑，整个人跟滚动的车轱辘似的，癫狂旋转，根本不心疼脚上那双新靴子，小路上扬起无数尘土。
高大少年出了小镇，一路由北向南走，只要走过宋大人出钱建造的廊桥，再走三四里路，就到了阮家父女开办的那座铁匠铺，刘羡阳其实一向心高气傲，但是阮师傅只用一句话，就让少年佩服得五体投地，“我们来这里，只为开炉铸剑。”
铸剑好啊，刘羡阳一想到自己将来就能有一把真剑，就忍不住兴奋起来，丢了树枝，开始边跑边喊，鬼哭狼嚎。
刘羡阳想着阮师傅私下传授的那几个拳架子，就开始练习起来，倒也有模有样，虎虎生风。
少年与廊桥越来越近。
廊桥北端的台阶上，坐着四个人，姿态婀娜的丰腴美妇，怀里抱着一个大红袍子的男孩，他高高扬起下巴，像是一位刚刚获得大捷的将军，台阶那一头，坐着个满头霜雪的高大老人身边，老人正在小声安慰一位气鼓鼓的小女孩，她粉雕玉琢，宛如世上最精巧的瓷娃娃，她的稚嫩肌肤在阳光照耀下，晶莹剔透，以至于能够清晰看到皮肤下的一条条青筋脉络。
两个孩子刚刚吵完架，小女孩泫然欲泣，小男孩愈发得意，
老人身材魁梧，如同一座小山，旁边的妇人投来一个致歉的眼神，威严老人对此视而不见。
台阶底下，还站着个姓卢的年轻人，正是卢氏家主的嫡长孙，叫卢正淳，兴许是真的一方水土，能够养育一方人，在小镇土生土长的人物，皮囊相貌总要生得比别处男女更好些。只不过卢正淳早就被酒色掏空了底子，落在台阶坐着的四人眼中，就更是不堪入目。卢家拥有的龙窑，无论数目还是规模，都冠绝于小镇，也是族内子弟走出小镇，去外地开枝散叶最多的一个姓氏。可是以往在小镇威风八面的卢正淳，神色拘谨，脸色苍白，整个人都紧绷起来，好像稍有纰漏就会被人抄家诛九族。
男孩说着小镇百姓听不懂的话，“娘亲，这个姓刘的小虫子，祖上真是那位……”
当他刚要说出姓名，妇人立即捂住孩子嘴巴，“出门前，你爹与你叮嘱过多少次了，在这里，不可轻易对谁指名道姓。”
男孩掰开妇人的手，眼神炙热，压低嗓音问道：“他家当真代代传承了宝甲和剑经？”

妇人宠溺地摸着幼子脑袋，柔声道：“卢氏用半部族谱担保，两件东西还藏在那少年家中。”
男孩突然撒娇道：“娘亲娘亲，咱们能不能跟小白家换一下宝物啊，咱们谋划的那具宝甲实在太丑了，娘亲你想啊，换成那部剑经的话，就能够梦中飞剑取头颅，当真是神不知鬼不觉，岂不是比一个乌龟壳厉害太多？”
不等妇人解释其中渊源缘由，隔壁那边的女孩已经怒气冲冲道：“就凭你也想染指我们失传已久的镇山之宝？此次我们来此，是名正言顺的物归原主，可不像某些不要脸的家伙，是做强盗、做小偷、甚至是做乞丐来着！”
男孩转头做了个鬼脸，然后讥笑道：“臭丫头你自己也说了，是镇‘山’之宝，山门辈分而已，了不起啊？”
男孩突然变换嬉笑脸色，从妇人怀中站起身后，眼神怜悯地俯视小女孩，像是学塾先生在训斥幼稚蒙童，“大道长生，逆天行事，只在争字。你连这点道理都不懂，以后如何继承家业，又如何恪守祖训？你们正阳山后裔，历代子孙务必每隔三十年，就需要拔高正阳山至少一百丈，臭丫头，你以为从你爷爷到你爹，做得很轻松不成？”
小女孩有些输了气势，神色萎靡，耷拉着脑袋，不敢正视那个男孩。
满头霜雪的魁梧老人沉声道：“夫人，虽说童言无忌，但是万一害得我家少主道心蒙尘，你们自己掂量后果。”
妇人妩媚一笑，重新将脸色阴沉的幼子拽回怀中，绵里藏针道：“孩子吵架拌嘴而已，猿前辈何须如此上纲上线，莫要坏了咱们两家的千年友谊。”
不曾想老人脾气刚烈至极，直接顶回去一句，“我正阳山，开山两千六百年，有恩报恩，虽千年不忘，有怨报怨，从无过夜仇！”
妇人笑了笑，没有做意气之争。
此次小镇之行，人人身负重任，尤其是她，更是将自己的身家性命、儿子的前程、娘家的底蕴，三者都孤注一掷，豪赌一场。
这位妇人，虽然衣裳朴素，却气态雍容，只是小镇百姓没有见过世面，不知其中关窍玄机。
从头到尾，卢正淳始终背对着廊桥台阶。
之前第一次在卢氏大宅见到这些贵客，自己的那个亲弟弟，不过是年轻气盛，定力不够，这才暂时忘却祖父的告诫，忍不住偷瞄了一眼美妇人的胸脯，便被气得浑身发抖的祖父让人拖下去，活活杖杀在庭院中，好像行刑的时候嘴里塞满了棉布，所以继续陪着祖父在大堂议事的卢正淳，既听不到弟弟的凄惨哀嚎，也见不到血肉模糊的画面。等到商议完毕，一起出门寻找那个姓刘的少年，卢正淳跨出大堂门槛，才发现庭院当中，血迹早已清洗干净。那四位远道而来的客人，哪怕是如同金童玉女的那双小孩子，对此也毫无异样，仿佛这就是天经地义的事情。
那一刻，卢正淳有些茫然。
死了一个人，怎么像是比死了一条狗还不如？
何况那个人还姓卢，在前一天深夜，与他这个哥哥喝酒壮胆的时候，无比雀跃，说是以后一定要飞黄腾达，光耀门楣，兄弟二人再不做井底之蛙了，要联手在外边闯出一片天地。
直到走出卢家大宅后，卢正淳的脑子仍是一片空白。
在那之后，卢正淳就开始心生恐惧，陌生贵人们问话的时候，他说话嗓音会颤抖，带路的时候，走路步伐会飘忽，他知道自己这个样子，会贻笑大方，会让祖父失望，让家族蒙羞，但是年轻人实在是控制不住自己的恐惧，好像全身都在从骨子里渗出寒气。
祖父在去年年关，带他们兄弟走入一间密室，告诉他们一个消息，卢家很快就要为某些贵人办事，是天大的福分，一定要小心办事，做成了，卢家会将报酬变成栽培兄弟二人的敲门砖，只要贵人愿意点点头，那么以后他们兄弟脚下，就会出现一条阳关大道，平步青云，最终获得无法想象的荣华富贵。那个时候，他才明白为何自己和弟弟，需要从小就学习那么多种稀奇古怪的方言。

卢正淳看着那个越来越靠近廊桥的刘羡阳，他突然开始无比仇恨这个人，这个曾经被自己带人堵在小巷里的穷光蛋，死狗一般躺在地上，如果不是某个小王八蛋跑到巷口那边喊死人了，他和几个死党原本已经按照约定，正要脱裤子，给地上那个不识抬举的少年，当头降下一场甘霖。卢正淳直到现在，也不明白什么这些高高在上的贵人，为何会对刘羡阳刮目相看，至于他们所谓的什么宝甲、剑经，什么正阳山，长生大道，还有什么争机缘抢气运等等，卢正淳好像都听得懂，其实又都听不懂。
但是卢正淳能够很确定一件事，就是他无比希望刘羡阳死在这里。
至于真正的原因，卢正淳不敢承认，也不愿深思。
在内心深处，卢正淳绝对不希望卑贱如狗的刘羡阳，见到自己这位锦衣玉食的卢家大少，竟然沦落到跟他姓刘的一个鸟样。
奇耻大辱，莫过于此。
美妇人望着那个喃喃道：“来了。”
高大少年一路打拳而来，到后来出拳迅猛，越打越快，以至于少年的身形都被拳势裹挟，有些踉跄。
在行家眼中，初具雏形的拳意当中，已经透出一丝刚柔并济的大成风范。
武道拳法一途，有句入门口诀：不得拳真意，百年门外汉。一悟拳真意，十年打鬼神。
美妇人如释重负，果不其然，这个姓刘的少年就是他们要找之人，确实天赋不俗，哪怕是在他们的那些仙家府邸里，根骨资质也不容小觑。
当然了，在美妇人和魁梧白发老人的广袤世界里，数量最多的，也正是这种人。
美妇人站起身，对台阶底下的卢正淳吩咐道：“你去告诉那少年，问他想要什么，才愿意拿出铠甲和书籍这两样传家宝。”
卢正淳转过身的同时，就已经低头躬身，同样用小镇百姓绝对听天书的某种方言，回答道：“是，夫人。”
妇人淡然道：“
男孩伸出手指，居高临下，厉色道：“坏了大事，本公子就将你剥皮抽筋，再把你的魂魄炼制成为灯芯，要你灯灭之前，时时刻刻生不如死！”
卢正淳吓得打了个激灵，弯腰更多，惶恐不安道：“小人绝不会误事！”
小女孩终于觉得扳回一城，嗤笑道：“在这些凡夫俗子面前，倒是威风十足，不知道是谁在来的路上，被同道中人当面骂做野种，也不敢还手。”
魁梧老人对那对势利眼母子，其实一开始就观感极差，于是补了一句，“小姐说错了，哪里是不敢还手，分明是不敢还嘴。”
一袭鲜艳红袍的男孩，咬牙切齿，死死盯住女孩，脸色阴森，但是也没有什么撂狠话，最后反而展颜一笑，很是灿烂。
妇人更是视线始终放在前方道路上，脸色云淡风轻，至于她是否心生芥蒂，天晓得。

小女孩冷哼一声，跑下台阶，蹲在溪边，低头望向水里的游鱼。
偶尔有成群结队的鲤鱼，在她视线里游曳而过，数目不等，红青两色皆有。
一些个小镇上了岁数的老人，在老槐树底下闲聊的时候，经常说在雷雨天气里，他们经过廊桥的时候，都曾看到桥底下游出过一尾金灿灿的鲤鱼。
只是有老人说那条金色鳞片的鲤鱼，大小不过手掌长短，也有人说那条奇怪鲤鱼，大得很，最少也有半人长，简直就是快成精了。
众说纷纭，老人们争来争去，以至于听故事的孩子们谁也不愿意当真。
此时，小女孩凝视着那条清澈见底的小溪，双手托着腮帮，目不转睛。
白发老人蹲坐在她身边，轻声笑道：“小姐，如果卢家没有说谎，这份大机缘已经落入别人口袋了。”
小女孩转过头，咧嘴笑道：“猿爷爷，说不定有两条的！”
于是她露出缺了一颗门牙的滑稽光景。
小女孩很快意识到这一点，赶紧伸手捂住嘴巴。
老人忍住笑意，解释道：“还未走江的蛟龙之属，最讲究划分地盘，不允许同类靠近。所以……”
小女孩哦了一声，重新转过头后，双手托着腮帮发呆，喃喃道：“万一有呢。”
在小女孩这边始终慈眉善目的老人，第一次流露出威严长辈的神色，伸手轻轻按住女孩的脑袋，沉声道：“小姐，切记，这‘万一’二字，委实是我辈头号死敌，决不可心存侥幸！小姐你虽是金枝玉叶之身……”
小女孩抽出一只手，使劲挥动，娇憨抱怨道：“知道啦知道啦，猿爷爷，我的耳朵要起茧子啦。”
老人说道：“小姐，我去盯着那边的动静了，对方虽然是咱们正阳山台面上的盟友，但是那一大家子人的秉性品行，呵，不提也罢，省得脏了小姐的耳朵。”
她只是挥手赶人。
他只好无奈离去。
这位身份像是家奴的魁梧老人，双手垂膝，走路之时，后背微驼，如负重而行。
岸边的女孩，突然使劲揉了揉眼睛。
她发现小溪里的水位，分明开始缓缓上涨，肉眼可见！

若是在小镇之外，例如在正阳山，或是在家乡任何地方，哪怕是整条小溪流水瞬间干涸，她也不会有半点惊奇。
小女孩疑惑道：“不是说在这里天然封禁一切玄术、神通和道法吗？而且越是修为高深，反噬越是厉害吗？猿爷爷就说过，哪怕是传说中的那个人，在这里待得时间久了，如今差不多也是泥菩萨过江的艰难处境，很难真正阻止谁动手争夺……”
她最后晃了晃脑袋，懒得再想这个谜题了。
小女孩转头望去，看着猿爷爷的高大背影。
她欢快想着，等到这里彻底开禁之后，她就请求猿爷爷将那座名叫披云山的山峰搬走。
带回家乡后，当做她的小花圃。

There is a well in Xinghua Lane, called the Iron Lock Well. An iron chain as thick as a strong young arm hangs from the well mouth year after year. When did this well have such an iron lock, and who did this boring and strange thing, no one knows the truth. Even the oldest old man in the town cannot tell how ugly he is.
It is rumored that there was once a meddlesome person in the town who tried to test how long the iron chain was. Despite the dissuasion of the old people, he did not take the old rule that was passed down by word of mouth seriously at all. After pulling hard on a stick of incense, he pulled out a lot of iron chains, but there was still no sign of the end. The man was exhausted, so he let the iron chains pulled out of the well mouth twist around the well. He said he would come back tomorrow, but he just didn't believe it. After the man returned home, he bled from all his orifices that day and died suddenly on his bed. No matter how hard his family tried, the body couldn't close its eyes. Finally, an old man who had lived near the well for generations asked the family to carry the body to the well, and watched helplessly as the old man put the chains back into the well. When the whole chain was submerged straight into the deep water at the mouth of the well, the body finally closed its eyes.
An old man and a young child slowly walked towards the iron lock well. The little guy was a child with two slugs hanging from his nose. But when he told this story, he spoke clearly and methodically. He didn't look like a country boy who had only been in school for half a year. At this time, the child raised his head and looked up. The child's big eyes were like two black grapes. He sniffed slightly, and the two snot snakes retracted. The child looked at the storyteller holding a big white bowl in one hand, pursed his lips, and said, "I've finished talking, you should show me what's in your bowl, right?"
The old man chuckled and said, "Don't worry, don't worry, I'll wait until I sit down by the well and I'll show you enough."
The child "kindly" reminded: "Don't go back on your word, or you will die a good death. You will fall into the iron lock well as soon as you get to it. I won't fish out the body for you then. Otherwise, there will be a sudden thunder, which will just chop you into a piece of coke. Then I will take a stone and break it bit by bit..."
The old man had a headache listening to the child pouring beans out of a bamboo tube, a long list of vicious and unfavorable words without repetition, and quickly said: "I'll show you, by the way, who did you learn these words from?"
The child said categorically: "Follow my mother!"
The old man sighed with emotion: "He is indeed an outstanding person and a beautiful person."
The child suddenly stopped and frowned: "Are you swearing? I know some people like to say good things in reverse, such as Song Jixin!"
The old man quickly denied it, then changed the subject and asked, "Do strange things often happen in this small town?"
The child nodded.
The old man asked: "Tell me about it."
The child pointed at the old man and said seriously: "For example, you are carrying a big white bowl, but you refuse to let anyone put copper coins in it. Before you finished telling the story, my mother said that your story was not bad. You were in the fog, and it looked like you were used to deception. So you asked me to give you a few pennies. If you don't want it, what is in the bowl?"
The old man couldn't laugh or cry.
It turned out that the storyteller who had finished telling the story under the old locust tree asked the child to lead him to the Xinghua Lane to see the well. The child was not happy at first, but the old man said that his big white bowl was very special and filled with rare things. The child was born lively and active, and his parents said he forgot to grow a butt when he was reincarnated. He liked to wander around with Liu Xianyang's gang of libertines since he was very young. However, in order to catch an eel or a loach, this little kid could stand in the sun for half an hour, motionless, and his patience was amazing.
So when the old man said what was in the white bowl, the child immediately bit the bait and took the bait.
Even if the old man made a weird request at first, saying that he wanted to try lifting him to see how heavy he was, I would like to knowAsked if it weighed forty pounds, the child nodded in agreement without hesitation. Anyway, no piece of meat would fall off after being lifted a few times.
But something happened that made the child roll his eyes again and again. The old man holding the bowl in the palm of his left hand used his right hand to lift him five or six times, but failed to lift him once. The child finally glanced sideways at the old man's thin arms and legs, shook his head, thinking that he was also a thin man, but Chen Ping'an, a pauper, was much stronger than this old man. I just thought that I had not yet seen the scene in the white bowl, as if a child was born to wake up early, so I refrained from saying some words that would make the old man unable to step down. You must know that in the area of ​​​​Niping Alley and Xinghua Alley, when it comes to quarreling and swearing, especially when it comes to yin and yang, this child ranks third. The second is the scholar Song Jixin, and the first is this child's mother.
The old man came to the well, but did not sit on the wellhead.
The ancient well is made of blue bricks.
Invisibly, the old man's breathing became heavy.
The child walked to the well, turned his back to the well mouth, jumped back, and sat on the well mouth with his buttocks.
This scene made the old man break out in cold sweat. If he hadn't been careful, that bastard would have fallen directly. With the historical origin of this ancient well, it would be difficult to collect the body.
The old man slowly took a few steps forward, squinted his eyes, and leaned over to examine the iron lock, one end of which was tied to the bottom of the well's windlass.
"The Feng Shui resort is the best on the continent."
The old man looked around, with mixed feelings, and thought to himself: "I don't know who will end up with this important weapon?"
The old man stretched out his free left hand and stared at the palm of his hand.
The lines on the palms are mottled and complex.
But a new line appeared, slowly extending, like a crack in cracked porcelain.
When a god looks at the palm of his hand, it is like looking at mountains and rivers.
It's just that this old man is only looking at himself at the moment.
The old man frowned and exclaimed: "In just half a day, the situation has already been so bleak, aren't those people the same?"
The child was already standing at the mouth of the well, with one hand on his hip and one finger pointing at the old man, urging loudly: "Will you show me the white bowl or not?!"
The old man said helplessly: "Come down quickly, come down quickly, and I will show you the big white bowl."
The child was doubtful and finally jumped down the wellhead.
The old man hesitated for a moment and then said solemnly, "Little boy, we are destined to show you the mystery of this bowl. However, after you have seen it, you are not allowed to mention it to outsiders, not even your mother. If you can do it, I will let you see it. If you can't, your little boy will poke you in the spine without even giving you a half-eye."
The child blinked, "Let's get started."
The old man solemnly walked forward to the wellhead. When he lowered his head, he found that the bastard was sitting on the wellhead with his legs spread apart this time. The old man regretted that he had provoked this lawless little kid.
The old man put aside his distracting thoughts, faced the mouth of the well, grasped the bottom of the large white bowl with his five fingers, and began to tilt his palm slightly, the amplitude was almost undetectable.
The child felt that he had been waiting for a long time, but he did not see any movement in the white bowl above his head, and the old man always maintained that posture.
Just before the child's two slugs were about to reach his mouth, his patience ran out.
I saw a stream of water as thin as a finger pouring out from the white bowl and falling into the depths of the well, making no sound.
If a child grits his teeth, he will be yelled at.
He suddenly closed his mouth, a little surprised. After a while, the child's face changed from shock to confusion. Then, the child became frightened, suddenly came to his senses, jumped down the wellhead, and ran away to his home.
It turned out that the amount that the old man poured into the well with that white bowl had long been more than a large water tank.
But water kept pouring out from the white bowl.
The child felt that he must have seen a ghost during the day.

Liu Xianyang casually broke off a branch that had just sprouted from the side of the road and started practicing his sword. His whole body was like a rolling wheel.I was spinning wildly, not caring about the new boots on my feet, and countless dust was raised on the path.
The tall young man left the town and walked from north to south. As long as he walked across the covered bridge built with Master Song's money, and walked three or four miles further, he arrived at the blacksmith shop run by the Ruan family and his daughter. Liu Xianyang had always been arrogant, but Master Ruan made the young man fall in admiration with just one sentence, "We are here just to open the furnace and make swords."
Sword-making is great. When Liu Xianyang thought that he would have a real sword in the future, he couldn't help but get excited. He dropped the branch and started running and shouting, crying and howling.
Liu Xianyang thought about the few boxing frames that Master Ruan had taught him privately, and began to practice them, which turned out to be quite impressive.
The boy and the covered bridge are getting closer and closer.
On the steps at the north end of the covered bridge, there were four people sitting, a plump and beautiful woman with a graceful posture, holding a boy in a red robe in her arms. He raised his chin high, like a general who had just won a great victory. At the other end of the steps, sat a tall old man with his head covered with frost and snow. Next to him, the old man was whispering comfort to an angry little girl. She was carved like the most exquisite porcelain doll in the world. Her tender skin was so crystal clear under the sunlight that you could clearly see the veins under her skin.
The two children had just finished their quarrel. The little girl was about to cry, and the little boy was getting more and more proud.
The old man was as tall as a hill. The woman next to him cast an apologetic look, but the majestic old man turned a blind eye.
At the bottom of the steps, there was a young man named Lu standing. He was the eldest grandson of the head of the Lu family, named Lu Zhengchun. Perhaps the land and water could really support a person. People who were born and raised in a small town would always have better skin and appearance than men and women elsewhere. However, Lu Zhengchun had long been drained by drinking and sex, and he was even more unsightly in the eyes of the four people sitting on the steps. The number and scale of the dragon kilns owned by the Lu family are second to none in the small town. It is also the surname with the most children of the family leaving the small town and branching out to other places. However, Lu Zhengchun, who used to be very powerful in the small town, looked reserved and pale, and his whole body tensed up, as if if he made the slightest mistake, his home would be ransacked and the nine clansmen would be executed.
The boy said something that the people in the town couldn't understand, "Mom, this little bug named Liu is really the ancestor..."
When he was about to say his name, the woman immediately covered the child's mouth and said, "Before going out, your father has told you so many times that you should not name anyone easily here."
The boy opened the woman's hand, his eyes were hot, and he asked in a low voice: "Is it true that his family has passed down the treasure armor and sword scripture from generation to generation?"
The woman patted the youngest son's head lovingly and said softly: "Ms. Lu guarantees with half of the tribe's genealogy that the two things are still hidden in the boy's home."
The boy suddenly said coquettishly: "Mother, mother, can we exchange the treasures with the Xiaobai family? The armor we planned is really ugly. Mother, think about it, if it were replaced by the sword scripture, I could take the head with a flying sword in my dream. Isn't it much more powerful than a turtle shell?"
Before the woman could explain the origin, the girl next door had already said angrily: "Why do you want to get your hands on our long-lost treasure? This time we are here to return the property to its original owner, unlike some shameless guys who are robbers, thieves, or even beggars!"
The boy turned around and made a face, then sneered: "You said it yourself, bitch, it's the treasure of the mountain. It's just the seniority of the mountain. Isn't it amazing?"
The boy's face suddenly changed to a smile. After standing up from the woman's arms, he looked down at the little girl with pity, as if a school teacher was scolding a childish boy, "The great path to immortality, acting against nature, just fighting for words. If you don't even understand this principle, how will you inherit the family business in the future, and how will you abide by the ancestral precepts? You descendants of Zhengyang Mountain, all generations of descendants must alwaysAfter thirty years, it will be necessary to raise Zhengyang Mountain by at least one hundred feet. Damn girl, do you think it will be easy from your grandfather to your father? "
The little girl lost some momentum, looked sluggish, hung her head, and did not dare to look at the boy.
The burly old man with a frost-covered head said in a deep voice: "Madam, although a child's words are unbridled, if it makes my young master's Taoist heart fall into dust, you must weigh the consequences yourself. "
The woman smiled charmingly, pulled the gloomy-faced son back into her arms, and said, "The children are just quarreling and bickering. Why should Senior Yuan get into trouble like this? Don't ruin the thousand-year friendship between our two families." "
Unexpectedly, the old man had a strong temper, so he directly retorted, "I, Zhengyang Mountain, have been here for 2,600 years, and I have always repaid kindness, even though I have never forgotten it for thousands of years, and I have never paid a night of grudges! "
The woman smiled and did not argue.
In this trip to the small town, everyone has a heavy responsibility, especially her, who is risking her life, her son's future, and her family's heritage.
Although this woman was dressed in simple clothes, she looked graceful and graceful. However, the people in the small town had never seen the world and did not know the secret behind it.
From beginning to end, Lu Zhengchun always had his back to the steps of the covered bridge.
It was the first time I saw these distinguished guests at the Lu family's mansion. My younger brother was just young and energetic, and lacked determination. He temporarily forgot his grandfather's warning and couldn't help but take a peek at the beautiful woman's breasts, and he was so angry that he was shaking all over. His grandfather was dragged down and killed with a cane in the courtyard, as if his mouth was stuffed with cotton during the execution. Therefore, Lu Zhengchun, who continued to accompany his grandfather to discuss matters in the lobby, could neither hear his brother's miserable wails nor see the bloody scene. After the discussion was over, and they went out together to look for the young man named Liu, Lu Zhengchun stepped out of the lobby and found that the blood stains in the courtyard had already been cleaned away. The four guests who came from afar, even the little children who looked like golden boys and girls, had no problem with this, as if this was a matter of course.
At that moment, Lu Zhengchun was a little confused.
Why is the death of a human being worse than the death of a dog?
What's more, that man's surname was Lu. Late the night before, when he and his brother were drinking to strengthen their courage, they were extremely excited, saying that they would become prosperous and shine in the future. The two brothers would no longer be frogs in the well, but would join forces to create a world outside.
Until he walked out of the Lu family's mansion, Lu Zhengchun's mind was still blank.
After that, Lu Zhengchun began to feel fear. When strangers and nobles asked questions, his voice would tremble, and when he led the way, his steps would be erratic. He knew that he would make people laugh, disappoint his grandfather, and bring shame to the family. But the young man really couldn't control his fear, as if coldness was oozing out of his bones.
At the end of last year, my grandfather took the brothers into a secret room and told them the news that the Lu family would soon be working for some noble people, which was a great blessing. They had to be careful and if the work was done, the Lu family would turn the reward into a stepping stone to cultivate the two brothers. As long as the noble people were willing to nod, then in the future, the brothers would have a bright road under their feet, and they would rise to the top, and eventually achieve unimaginable glory and wealth. At that time, he understood why he and his brother needed to learn so many weird dialects from an early age.
Lu Zhengchun looked at Liu Xianyang who was getting closer and closer to the covered bridge. He suddenly began to hate this person extremely. This pauper who had been blocked in the alley by his own people was lying on the ground like a dead dog. If some little bastard hadn't run to the alley entrance and called him dead, he and a few of his buddies had already agreed to take off their pants and rain down on the young man on the ground who didn't know how to lift. Until now, Lu Zhengchun still doesn't understand why these high-ranking nobles treat Liu XianyangLooking at it with admiration, Lu Zhengchun seemed to understand everything they called Baojia, Sword Sutra, Zhengyang Mountain, the Avenue of Immortality, fighting for opportunities and luck, etc., but in fact he couldn't understand them.
But Lu Zhengchun was certain of one thing, that is, he extremely hoped that Liu Xianyang would die here.
As for the real reason, Lu Zhengchun did not dare to admit it, nor did he want to think deeply.
Deep down in his heart, Lu Zhengchun absolutely did not want Liu Xianyang, who was as humble as a dog, to see himself, the eldest son of the Lu family, reduced to a bird like Liu Xianyang.
There is no greater shame or humiliation than this.
The beautiful woman looked at that one and murmured: "Here he comes."
The tall boy was punching all the way, and then he was punching fast and violently, faster and faster, so that the boy's body was wrapped up in the punches and he staggered a little.
In the eyes of experts, the rudimentary boxing intention already reveals a hint of Dacheng style that combines strength and softness.
On the way to martial arts boxing, there is an introductory saying: Without the true meaning of boxing, a layman of a hundred years. Once you realize the true meaning of boxing, you can fight ghosts and gods for ten years.
The beautiful woman was relieved. As expected, this young man named Liu was the person they were looking for. He was indeed very talented. Even in their fairy mansions, his basic qualifications should not be underestimated.
Of course, in the vast world of beautiful women and burly white-haired old men, it is this kind of people who are the most numerous.
The beautiful woman stood up and told Lu Zhengchun who was at the bottom of the steps: "Go tell that young man and ask him what he wants before he is willing to take out these two family heirlooms: armor and books."
When Lu Zhengchun turned around, he already bowed his head and replied in a certain dialect that the people in the small town would definitely listen to. "Yes, madam."
The woman said calmly: "
The boy stretched out his finger, condescendingly, and said sternly: "If you mess up something big, I will skin you and cramp you, and then refine your soul into a wick. I will make you live worse than death every moment until the lamp goes out!" "
Lu Zhengchun was so frightened that he trembled, bent down even more, and said in fear: "A villain will never mess up! "
The little girl finally felt that she had regained some ground, and sneered: "In front of these ordinary people, she is very majestic. I don't know who was on the way here, but she was called a bastard by her colleagues in front of her, and she didn't dare to fight back. "
The burly old man actually had a very bad impression of the snobbish mother and son from the beginning, so he added, "The lady said something wrong. She clearly didn't dare to fight back. "
The boy in a bright red robe gritted his teeth and stared at the girl with a gloomy expression, but he didn't say anything harsh. In the end, he smiled brightly.
The woman's eyes were always on the road ahead, and her face was calm and calm. As for whether she had a grudge in her heart, God knows.
The little girl snorted coldly, ran down the steps, squatted by the stream, and looked down at the fish swimming in the water.
Occasionally, groups of carp swam past her sight, varying in number, both red and green.
When chatting under the old locust tree, some elderly people in the small town often said that when they passed the covered bridge during thunderstorms, they had seen a golden carp swimming under the bridge.
However, some old people said that the carp with golden scales was no bigger than the length of a hand, and some people said that the strange carp was very big, at least half the length of a human being, and it was almost a sperm.
There were many different opinions and the old people were arguing about it, so that no one among the children who listened to the story wanted to take it seriously.
At this time, the little girl stared at the crystal clear stream, holding her chin in her hands, staring intently.
The white-haired old man squatted beside her and chuckled: "Miss, if the Lu family hadn't lied, this great opportunity would have fallen into someone else's pocket. "
The little girl turned her head and grinned: "Grandpa Ape, maybe there are two! "
Then she showed the funny sight of missing one of her front teeth.
The little girl quickly realized this and quickly covered her mouth with her hand.
The old man enduresKeeping his smile on his face, he explained: "Those of the Jiaolong family who have not yet crossed the Yangtze River are very particular about dividing their territory and not allowing similar people to get close to them. So..."
The little girl said oh, turned her head again, held her chin in her hands in a daze, and murmured: "What if."
The old man, who was always kind to the little girl, showed the look of a majestic elder for the first time. He stretched out his hand and gently pressed the girl's head, and said in a deep voice: "Miss, remember, the word 'in case' is actually our number one mortal enemy. You must not take any chances! Miss, although you are a golden person..."
The little girl took out one hand, waved it vigorously, and complained Jiaohan: "I know, I know, Grandpa Ape, my ears are going to get calluses."
The old man said: "Miss, I'm going to keep an eye on what's going on over there. Although the other party is our ally on the Zhengyang Mountain stage, the character and conduct of that family, oh, it's okay not to mention it, so as not to dirty the ears of the lady."
She just waved people away.
He had no choice but to leave.
This burly old man, who looked like a domestic slave, had his hands hanging on his knees. When he walked, his back was slightly hunched, as if he was carrying a heavy load.
The girl on the shore suddenly rubbed her eyes vigorously.
She discovered that the water level in the creek had clearly begun to slowly rise, visible to the naked eye!
If outside a small town, such as in Zhengyang Mountain, or anywhere in her hometown, she would not be surprised at all if the entire stream dried up in an instant.
The little girl wondered: "Isn't it said that all mystical arts, magical powers and Taoism are naturally banned here? And the higher the level of cultivation, the more severe the backlash? Grandpa Ape said that even if the person in the legend has been here for a long time, he is now in the same difficult situation as the Clay Bodhisattva crossing the river. It is difficult to really stop anyone from fighting for it..."
She finally shook her head, too lazy to think about the puzzle any more.
The little girl turned her head and looked at the tall back of Grandpa Ape.
She thought happily that after the ban was completely lifted here, she would ask Grandpa Yuan to move the peak named Piyun Mountain.
After taking it back to her hometown, she used it as her little flower garden.
